Sir '''Halfar of Kul Tiras''' is a human located at the [[Jousting Grounds]] in [[Northwind]]. One of the participants in the Northwind jousting tournament representing the [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|kingdom of Kul Tiras]], he faces off against [[the Black Knight]].
